files.thread: Held pending · steer and queue · QA
files.observation: The shared tray shows two held steer messages above a three-message pending-send section; its native vertical thumb is visible before tray interaction. Lower rows extend below the visible tray boundary. This image does not demonstrate scrolling or access to every row.
The local QA_REJECT recovery row says Delivery not confirmed, retains the may-already-have-been-accepted warning and offers Check delivery. No completed-check label is present.
After the first operator-reported explicit check, the settled row visibly reads: Check completed. Delivery is still unconfirmed. The original recovery copy remains.
After typing Keep this newer draft unsent. and the second operator-reported explicit check, the qualified settled result and recovery row remain, and the newer draft is still in the editor.
After operator-reported navigation to the pending thread and back, the recovery row and newer draft remain. The previous completed-check label is gone and Check delivery is available again.

readbackVerification.conclusion: The retained synthetic records show one rejected send and no additional accepted input or model run during these checks/navigation. They do not log the read-only check clicks individually, prove real-provider behavior, or turn UI uncertainty into non-delivery authority.

independentReview.status: Original P2 full-read identity and P3 fixture-isolation findings retained; independent rereview marks both resolved within scope.

limits: No native capture of transient Checking delivery; its status/announcement behavior is covered by automated tests only.

Unavailable/failed reads, same-frame repeat fencing, full-window equal/newer-watermark race, stale epoch/thread/late outcome scenarios and Chinese delivery labels remain automated-only for this checkpoint.
Repeat check count and navigation sequence come from the native operator; these screenshots show settled states, not an uninterrupted recording.
No screen-reader, contrast-compliance, touch, reduced-motion, forced-colors, dark-mode or narrow-window claim for these five captures.
Synthetic local model and pre-admission rejection injection, not a live remote provider/network reliability test. The native IPC presentation correctly remains conservative.
The corrected QA model emits only text/usage and rejects shell/tool command forms, but the fixture is not an OS firewall or global isolation of manual application/plugin actions.
The local recovery row and unsent draft remain restart-volatile. Navigation retention is not persistence across application restart.
Raw runtime profiles, credentials, ItemLists and Trace payloads are not copied into repository evidence; only bounded readback counts and fingerprints are recorded.
